author: musho7-dev
subject: Add paid roadside help: push over hills and fuel delivery
body:
- Stuck on a hill (gas held, not moving or rolling back for 1.5 s):
  "CALL HELP" button; a tractor drives in from behind and pushes the
  car up the slope for ~3 s while keeping it upright
- Out of fuel: "FUEL DELIVERY" button with a 6 s countdown; the helper
  refills the tank, otherwise the run ends as before
- Paid with coins (run coins first, then bank); price doubles with each
  use in a run (push 150/300/600, fuel 100/200/400)
- Fix: running dry in a valley no longer rolls back and forth forever;
  "not getting further" now counts as stopped
- Self-test exercises push and fuel delivery
